svg.title: How a Cloudflare Worker goes live
svg.desc: You merge a pull request into main, after every required check passed. Workers Builds of Cloudflare builds the commit with the lock file of the repository and runs npm run deploy, whose script asks whether the commit is a release. An ordinary commit becomes a version of the Worker without traffic, which the dashboard lists. The merge of the release pull request goes live with its version; the release workflow tags the same commit and publishes the release on GitHub, with its SBOMs and signed provenance. No key of Cloudflare is stored in GitHub.
